verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs say its core engines (Chandra, Marker and Surya) "remain free open source", and Marker has a public GitHub repo whose source community users have run and examined. However, the hosted platform features are not shown to be open (pipelines, form filling, track changes, segmentation), and running Datalab's models on your own infrastructure requires an Enterprise contract, so only part of the product's source is readable. Missing for 10: named license terms (e.g. the specific license and any commercial-use restrictions), open source for the hosted platform/API layer, and source repos for Chandra/Surya directly evidenced.
